message.content:
A medium‑sized apple (about 182 g) contains roughly **95 kcal**.  
Here’s a quick reference for common sizes:

| Size | Weight (g) | Calories |
|------|------------|----------|
| Small | ~149 | ~77 kcal |
| Medium | ~182 | ~95 kcal |
| Large | ~223 | ~116 kcal |

These numbers are averages; actual calorie counts can vary slightly depending on the apple variety, ripeness, and growing conditions.
